note: The hosts the games village adds (narrative/games_village.py): the sawyer at the sawmill, the water-carrier at the well, the Rollkeeper and the contestants on the green. They say a line or two and offer their games (the game choices come from minigames.json, not from here).

lines: What? Speak up. The saw. Twenty years of it.
Planks. I cut planks. Somebody ordered these and I cannot for the life of me remember who.
You again. Still cannot remember who the planks were for.
Stand on the left, I hear better on the left.
Mind the rope. Everybody minds the rope and everybody trips on it.
Forty buckets a day up this drum. You get to know every notch on it.
Back for the drum? It took three of my pebbles this morning. It always does.
The roll is open. Not the Trial's roll; this is the fire by the warehouse, and the only thing anybody loses here is pebbles.
Sit if you like. The contestants are passing the time until somebody calls them.
The fire is still lit and the roll is still open.
Waiting. That is most of a contest, in my experience: the waiting.
We play cards so we do not think about the gate.
